title: Lightest Frame Ever Tested  // Tavelo Attack // First Look

takeaways.text: In December 2023 the frameset cost US$1,580 plus shipping, including fork, seatpost, headset, spacers and a BB86 bottom bracket for Shimano 24 mm cranks.
His size 56 has 3 mm more stack and 3 mm less reach than his Winspace T1500, which he calls an all-rounder geometry.
His painted white-to-black size-L frame weighed 1,041 g with bottle-cage bolts removed but derailleur hardware fitted; the uncut fork weighed 443 g and the seatpost with clamp 156 g.

Fit and finish match other frames at this price: smooth headset and BB areas, faced bottom bracket and attention to the brake mounts; he notes some fiberglass in the steerer and says it is common practice.

disclosure: Panda Podium supplied the frameset for review.
summary: Unboxing and weigh-in of a Tavelo Attack frameset in Panda Podium paint, Tavelo's first model.
